usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing cluster-level USB hardware mapping — update which physical USB device each node maps to, change the description, or remove specific fields via 'delete'. Requires 'Mapping.Modify' on '/mapping/usb/{id}'. Pass the 'digest' from the current mapping to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other.

examples.summary: Remap a USB dongle to a different bus/port on node pve2 while clearing the old description

tips: The 'map' array must include an entry for every cluster node that should expose the device; nodes omitted from the list lose access to the mapping.
Use 'delete' (comma-separated config key names) to remove optional fields such as 'description' rather than setting them to empty strings.
Read the current mapping first (get_cluster_mapping_usb_id) to obtain the 'digest' value before updating — prevents silent overwrites in multi-admin environments.
USB mappings are referenced by VMs using the mapped ID; updating path values takes effect on the next VM start, not live.
